title: NIAID data catalog
description: A repository a NIAID Data Discovery Portal dataset comes from: its name and address, the dataset's page there (schema:archivedAt), and the version of the catalog the portal harvested (nde:versionDate).

schema:archivedAt.description: The dataset's page in this catalog.

nde:versionDate.description: The date of the version of the catalog the portal harvested.
